title: Implement case studies projects section
context: Add a new single-page Case Studies/Projects section with placeholder content and a flexible structure so any number of tiles and list elements can be added without code shape changes. Keep implementation route-ready for future extraction.

tasks.title: Build reusable projects section and wire into app
acceptance_criteria: A new projects section is rendered on the single-page app with clear section heading and id anchor for navigation.
Each project tile includes an image, title, and description area with a list of bullet items.
Project tiles are rendered from structured data arrays so there is no hard-coded limit on number of projects or bullet items.
Section uses placeholder content/images only and remains fully responsive in current theme system.
Existing verification command passes after the change.
